reseal_note: Re-sealed after the worker was made arm-aware. The contract pins the worker and the worker must read the contract, so the app hash necessarily moves once; sealing before that edit would have pinned a worker that cannot resolve the arm. No scientific field changed -- the two payloads still differ in exactly one top-level key.
